summary: Stops endpoint clustering from adding an empty relatedClusterIds property to diagnostics that name no clusters, which made re-planned or structurally cloned documents fail UPID validation before they were saved.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files or controller output. Saved documents never contained the empty property because JSON drops it; only in-memory documents were affected. Cluster ids, diagnostics and plans are otherwise unchanged.

checklist.schema: No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, CAD, storage or journal schema change. Post engine API remains 1; saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event, WebMCP tool, cancellation or input-version behavior change.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change. Diagnostics that name clusters keep the same renumbered ids; diagnostics that name none no longer carry an undefined relatedClusterIds key.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change and no cleanup of user files.
checklist.verification: New tests validate a drawing with ambiguous endpoint joins in memory and after structuredClone, and a saved drawing after moving an unrelated segment in the path editor; both fail without the fix. A randomized import fuzzer found the issue in 145 of 600 drawings and finds no structural, round-trip or execution-plan failures in 4,600 drawings after it, including randomized endpoint tolerance and coincidence epsilon. The pure-domain suite, tsc -b and npm run lint pass.

publicNotes.summary: Edited drawings with ambiguous endpoint joins no longer report an invalid project.
changes: After a path edit on a drawing where nearby endpoints could join more than one way, the edited project could fail validation, which blocks its execution plan. It now stays valid.
publicNotes.compatibility: Cut order, start points, directions and posted programs are unchanged. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and CAD files are unchanged.
